7695.title: Plain Markdown takes the full-document renderer during streaming
7695.rootCauseOneLine: A raw less-than character selects the full-document HTML renderer and bypasses the settled-piece cache even when the character is not HTML.

prReviews.topFinding: No blocker established; add preview-level parser-work coverage beyond HTML-summary metadata tests.

7695.proposedFix: Use actual HTML nodes in cached Markdown piece summaries to select sanitized whole-document rendering; retain incremental reuse for literal angles.
7695.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean clones. No frame-time profile or frequency measurement. Reproduction test is embedded in HTML under reports repository policy. No duplicate PR because #7702 is open.
